lines:
مهمة يتقرر فيها
مصير كائنات Kay
headline:
عرض جديد من Exodus
مدته 40 دقيقة
label: جديد
note: Archetype Entertainment released a 40-minute 'Liberating the Kay' mission gameplay video on 28 Oct (Gematsu 17:14Z quoting Archetype; IGN video page 17:37Z): the player seeks the Tenjin dynasty's aid against Gideon Aslan's forces for the orbital station Khonsu; choice paths; the fate of the Kay decided. Release 7 Apr 2027 (Steam page, our 24 Oct story). Footage: IGN 2560 copy (cinematic stretches letterboxed, 1080p would fall under 960 rows). Sound: our bed, reason: the video is a gameplay demo with dialogue running through the whole of it (transcribed at 150-210, 690-810, 1460-1490, 2040-2100, 2340-2400 s: speech throughout, one line about blood), so no stretch of its own sound can sit under story lines; Exodus's other trailers would not match the picture.
